verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a community note that GitLab's GitHub importer brings over milestones. That implies GitLab has milestones of its own, alongside general claims of planning and issue-tracking capability. Nothing documents how issues are grouped into milestones or whether milestones carry due dates. Missing for 10: first-party docs on milestones, evidence of milestone due dates, evidence of assigning issues to milestones, hands-on corroboration.
